title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.23478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. We propose Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level intent into the action decoder. During training, a frozen teacher VLM interprets a demonstrated segment from the current observation, instruction, coarse action summary, and corresponding execution video. From its standard inputs, the deployed VLA recovers the resulting multimodal intent representation at an int

translated_title: 意图驱动：为视觉-语言-动作模型提炼行为意图
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以将多模态上下文转化为机器人动作，但其动作解码器仍主要通过行为克隆进行训练。这种方法监督了演示的电机指令，却隐式地忽略了行为在指令下所服务的局部目标。基于未来的监督通过帧、潜在观测、轨迹或运动表示增强了动作学习，但这些信号捕捉的是可能发生的特定实现，而非未来行为的共享语义目标。我们提出了意图蒸馏（INDI），该方法将行为级别的意图提炼到动作解码器中。在训练期间，一个冻结的教师视觉语言模型（VLM）从当前观测、指令、粗略动作摘要和对应的执行视频中解释一个演示片段。通过其标准输入，部署的VLA模型在int（意图）级别恢复由此产生的多模态意图表示。
tldr: 本文提出意图蒸馏（INDI）方法，通过教师VLM提炼行为级别的语义意图到VLA动作解码器，克服行为克隆仅监督指令而忽略行为目标的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level semantic intent into VLA action decoders via a teacher VLM, addressing the limitation of behavior cloning that supervises commands but ignores behavioral objectives.
